visualCharacteristics: Two-column layout with a large feature image on one side and an article intro on the other (breadcrumb links, H2 heading, and a byline line with author, date, and read time). Columns sit side by side on desktop and stack on mobile with the image first.
contentPattern: One row, two cells: an image cell and a text cell (breadcrumb + heading + byline).
usage: Article header pairing a hero/feature image with introductory metadata.
